primaryContent.description:
Bally's Profit Boost - Increase Your Winnings up to 100%

Starts: 12:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, July 1, 2026

Ends: 11:59 p.m. ET on Thursday, December 31, 2026

Payout: Within 24 hours of the first qualifying sports wager settling as a win.

DESCRIPTION OF PROMOTION (MECHANIC)

This Promotion is offered to registered and fully verified Bally Bet Patrons during the Promotional Period (defined below) to boost the potential winnings of a Profit Boost Offering (defined below). Winnings from a Qualifying Wager that utilize a Profit Boost Token will be awarded as cash within 24 hours of your Qualifying Wager being settled as a win.

WHEN

Bally Bet Profit Boost offerings will be available at various points throughout the promotional period.

HOW

You can locate Bally Bet Profit Boost offerings by accessing the “Rewards” tab on the “My Bets” section of your account.

WHAT

A Profit Boost allows you to increase your potential winnings on a wager. When you apply a Profit Boost token to a bet, a percentage of extra profit will be added to your total payout if your bet wins.

Terms and Conditions

1. PROMOTION PERIOD

1.1. This Promotion will run daily between 12:00 a.m. ET on July 1, 2026, and 11:59 p.m. ET on Thursday, December 31, 2026 (the “Promotional Period”).

2. ELIGIBILITY

2.1. To be eligible for this promotion, you must:

(a) Be twenty-one years of age or over;

(b) Not be excluded or self-excluded by law from using the Platform as set forth in Section 4.1.6 of our Platform Terms and Conditions ;

(c) Be fully verified as a Patron on Bally Bet; and

(d) At the time of wagering, be physically located in Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Rhode Island, Tennessee, or Virginia;

2.2. Employees of Bally’s Corporation and group companies, and their immediate family members, their affiliates and subsidiaries are not permitted to participate in this Promotion.

2.3. Please visit https://play.ballybet.com/account/terms for additional eligibility information.

3. ACTION REQUIRED

3.1. This Promotion will be offered during the Promotional Period. To participate in this Promotion, you must place a wager on a Profit Boost Offering on the Platform (a “Qualifying Wager”) “Profit Boost Offering” means “a specific wager as designated by Bally’s, in its sole discretion, which qualifies for a Profit Boost Token.

4. CLAIMING PROMOTIONAL OFFER

4.1. If a registered and fully verified Patron fulfills the minimum bet requirements as set forth by Bally’s on the relevant Profit Boost Offering within the Platform, subject to the Bally Bet Standard Promotional Terms and Conditions, the Patron will receive up to a 100% Profit Boost Token in the Patron’s Rewards Tab within the Platform to use on an eligible wager.

5. REGISTRATION PROCEDURES

5.1. This promotion is only available to registered and fully verified Patrons. To register for a Bally Bet account, please download the Bally Bet Sportsbook mobile application from your app store or visit https://play.ballybet.com

6. RESTRICTIONS/EXCLUSIONS

6.1. Bonus Bet Tokens cannot be used for Profit Boost Offerings.

6.2. A Patron must select the Profit Boost Token from the Patron’s Reward tab before placing the wager to apply the boosted price.

6.3. Wagering on the Profit Boost Offering must use funds from the Patron’s cash balance.

6.4. Cash out voids participation. If your wager is voided for any reason, the promotion is cancelled and cannot be applied to another wager.

6.5. If your wager is settled as a push, then the promotion will not be applied, and the Patron’s next wager is not eligible for the promotion.

7. CANCELLATION

7.1. Patrons may cancel participation in this promotion by contacting Customer Support by emailing support@nj.ballybet.com (NJ Only), support@ballybet.com or visiting help.ballybet.com.

8. BONUS BET TOKEN

8.1. N/A

9. RESTRICTIONS ON WITHDRAWAL

9.1. Winnings from a Qualifying Wager that utilizes a Profit Boost Token will be awarded as cash within 24 hours of your Qualifying Wager being settled as a win.
